{{Top|leg}}
The '''Military Defense Act''' was a government bill passed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]]. Provision 878-BCM of the Act permitted Republic commanders to subcontract licensed combat specialists, such as [[Interstellar Commandos, Incorporated]].
